abstract: INTRODUCTION: The therapeutic procedures in the management of testicular cancer are determined by histological findings in the removed testis and by the extent of the disease at the time of diagnosis. However, all advanced tumors could be treated by primary chemotherapy regardless of the histological findings. The current imaging techniques (ultrasound of the testis, abdominal and chest CT examination) and laboratory tests (determination of serum tumor markers AFP and hCG) provide sufficient evidence for the presence of cancer. When the diagnosis of advanced tumor is evident, it is possible to start the treatment without orchiectomy. The aim of this study was to evaluate the advantages of neo-adjuvant chemotherapy with delayed orchiectomy in the management of advanced testicular cancer. MATERIAL AND METHODS: A total of 36 patients with advanced germ cell testicular cancer underwent primary PVB or BEP chemotherapy without previous orchiectomy. Mean age of patients was 32 years. Detailed medical, surgical and urological examination showed pulmonary metastases and/or extensive abdominal tumorous masses imitating acute abdominal crisis and impaired drainage of the kidney due to ureteral obstruction. Searching for the origin, testicular tumor was detected. Eleven patients had a bulky disease in the retroperitoneum (Stage IIC), two had enlarged retroperitoneal lymph nodes (Stage IIB), two had enlarged mediastinal lymph nodes (Stage III) and other 16 patients had also pulmonary metastases, and 5 pts had pulmonary metastases only. The patients were treated with cisplatin-containing combination chemotherapy. Following completion of chemotherapy, orchiectomy was performed alone or simultaneously with retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (RPLND) and/or lung metastasectomy in cases with persistent residual mass. Following orchiectomy the patients were regularly checked and in cases with viable malignant tumor found in the testis sequential chemotherapy was administered. Similarly when the relapse of the disease was detected, the patients were treated with sequential chemotherapy. RESULTS: Complete disappearance of metastases was observed in 12 patients following chemotherapy alone. The residual mass persisted in 24 patients (in 22 out of them in the retroperitoneum and in two patients also in the lungs) and was removed surgically. The viable tumor in the removed tissue was found in one patient. Delayed orchiectomy was performed simultaneously with surgical removal of residual mass in the retroperitoneum in 24 patients and as a separate procedure in 12 patients who have been considered to be complete responders following chemotherapy alone. Residual viable tumor in testicular specimen was found in three patients, necrotic or fibrotic tissue in 18, and mature teratoma in 15 patients. Overall survival of the patients was 26/36 (72.7%) at mean of 56.9 months (range 7-145 months, median 50 months) since the start of the treatment. CONCLUSIONS: In patients with advanced germ cell testicular cancer preference must be given to the early beginning of intensive chemotherapy without the need of tissue diagnosis of primary tumor that should be obtained by orchiectomy. Benefit of this therapeutic approach is the timely management of acute abdominal and/or pulmonary symptoms of life-threatening distant metastases.
abstract_ja: 背景：精巣がんの治療方針は、切除された精巣の組織所見と診断時の病変の広がりによって決定される。しかし、進行性腫瘍はすべて、原発巣の組織診断の有無にかかわらず、初回から化学療法で治療可能である。現在の画像診断(精巣超音波検査、腹部・胸部CT)と血清腫瘍マーカーであるAFPおよびhCGの測定により、がんの存在について十分な根拠が得られる。進行がんと診断が明らかな場合、精巣摘除術を行わずに治療を開始することが可能である。本研究の目的は、進行精巣がんにおける術前化学療法と遅延精巣摘除術の利点を評価することである。方法：進行性胚細胞性精巣がん患者36例が、精巣摘除術を行う前にPVBまたはBEP化学療法を受けた。平均年齢は32歳であった。詳細な内科的、外科的、泌尿器科的検査により、肺転移および/または急性腹症を模倣する大きな腹部腫瘤、尿管閉塞による腎盂の排液障害が認められた。原発巣を探索したところ、精巣腫瘍が検出された。11例は後腹膜に大きな病変を有し(病期IIC)、2例は後腹膜リンパ節の腫大を有し(病期IIB)、2例は縦隔リンパ節の腫大を有し(病期III)、残る16例は肺転移も有していた。5例は肺転移のみであった。患者はシスプラチンを含む併用化学療法で治療された。化学療法終了後、精巣摘除術を単独で、または残存腫瘤に対する後腹膜リンパ節郭清(RPLND)および/または肺転移巣切除と同時に行った。精巣摘除後は定期的に経過観察を行い、精巣に生存する悪性腫瘍が認められた場合は逐次化学療法を実施した。また、疾患の再発が認められた場合も逐次化学療法で治療した。結果：化学療法のみで転移の完全消失が12例で認められた。24例では残存腫瘤が持続し、そのうち22例は後腹膜、2例は肺にもみられ、外科的に切除された。切除組織に生存腫瘍が認められたのは1例であった。遅延精巣摘除術は、後腹膜の残存腫瘤の外科的切除と同時に24例で、化学療法のみで完全奏効と判断された12例では単独手術として実施された。精巣標本で生存腫瘍が認められたのは3例、壊死または線維化組織が18例、成熟奇形腫が15例であった。全生存期間(全生存率)は、治療開始後平均56.9か月(範囲7〜145か月、中央値50か月)の時点で26/36例(72.7%)であった。結論：進行性の胚細胞性精巣がん患者では、原発巣の組織診断を精巣摘除術で得る必要性を待たず、早期に集中的な化学療法を開始することが優先されるべきである。この治療戦略の利点は、生命を脅かす遠隔転移による急性腹症や肺症状を適切な時期に管理できることである。
